summary: Develop an Android hotel-service prototype with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, guest workflows, and API mapping. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Android app development for hotel services covers mapping guest journeys and turning check-in, room-service, and support needs into prototype screens. For Android developers and hospitality product teams, the training practises Kotlin models, Jetpack Compose layouts, navigation and screen state, REST API mapping, and guest-request workflows with staff handoffs, while considering accessibility and guest-data boundaries.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, build, or validate Android guest-service applications and need to connect hotel operations with workable app features.
modules: Hotel Guest Journeys and Android Scope
REST APIs and Hotel Service Data
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of a programming language and basic Android application concepts. Coding is required for the Kotlin and Jetpack Compose exercises. Advanced security and API topics receive introductory or operational treatment; production deployment is outside the course scope.
